content.bridge_context: Moving from folktales to real-life biography, this chapter celebrates the achievements and bravery of Kalpana Chawla, the first Indian-origin woman in space.

units.title: Breaking Barriers
units.explanation: Kalpana Chawla proved that with determination, dreams can be achieved regardless of where you are from.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss what 'determination' means to you. / चर्चा करें कि 'दृढ़ संकल्प' का आपके लिए क्या अर्थ है।

units.title: Space Exploration Basics
units.explanation: Astronauts travel in spacecraft (like the Space Shuttle Columbia) to study space and conduct experiments.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify terms like 'NASA', 'Orbit', 'Launch'. / 'NASA', 'Orbit', 'Launch' जैसे शब्दों को पहचानें।
